source: public/designs/template/template.svg guides (the template's own paths); continued routes are a PROPOSAL, not on the template
units: pt, template page units, y down; s = distance along the route from its star end

measure.bow: largest signed distance of the stretch from its chord, + towards the top of the page, pt

model.use: a generated line of chord c from A to B: point = A + x*c along the chord + y*c along the chord's upward normal (U); for D turn it 180 degrees: x -> 1-x, y -> -y. Scale by the chord, never by a chosen figure.

ud.note: U = hump, D = bowl, after the fork's first segment. Only top-right and bottom-left are printed on the template; the rule for the other two corners is this one switch (Tom's to set). Source: docs/KEMP-UD-CODES.md

tidy.note: printed offsets, measured on the template's own paths; crossings AND the switchbacks' step ends are snapped (mark.snap, stretch.fit); steps=printed leaves the step ends as printed (stretch.fit_steps_printed). drawn_max_off_guide_pt: the furthest a drawn printed stretch sits from its own printed path

step_range.note: the printed switchbacks' steps along a ring, pt: a generated step between two junctions stays within the largest
